items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The fix matches the reference: `self.query.get_initial_alias()` with the comment "# Ensure base table is in the query". The only nit is an extra trailing blank line after the new test in tests/delete/tests.py.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: It reuses the existing helper query.get_initial_alias() in single_alias and leaves Collector/QuerySet.delete untouched. No dead code or debug leftovers. The added test (test_fast_delete_all) is short and focused.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: A minimal one-line call to an existing idempotent helper. No new error paths or magic constants, and nothing is swallowed. Hidden tests pass (F2P 1/1, P2P 52/52).

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: The root cause is fixed in SQLDeleteCompiler.single_alias by registering the base alias before counting. Joined deletes still count multiple aliases, so they keep the subquery, and the MySQL compiler that relies on single_alias also benefits. There is no backend-specific branch.
